raw: Answers for every workbook page, the mistakes students make most, and a line to say when they get stuck. A ledger line is also spelled leger line (AMEB accepts both). Some books teach the ledger notes as four lists -- A C E above the treble staff, C A F below it, C E G above the bass staff, E C A below it; this book counts out of each land and reads from the five Cs instead. The lists' third notes between the lands (F three ladders under Queensland, G three ladders over Kingsland) come later. AMEB: Preliminary needs one ladder below Queensland; Grade 1 one ladder above and below both lands; Grade 2 up to three.
